payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source image, is there clear visible evidence that the same woman's jacket has been brought closer together along its front closure in the edited image?
node.criteria: Pass only if the source/edit comparison clearly shows some progress toward closing the jacket, even if a visible opening remains. Fail only if the closure is clearly assessable and shows no progress or is more open. Unknown if the changed pose, drape, or occlusion prevents a reliable comparison; low confidence alone is not sufficient for unknown.
node.binding: Assess the same woman's jacket in both images. Use the source to identify the garment and compare its front closure; do not infer closure from silhouette or drape. This check concerns progress, not complete fulfillment.
